title: Felix and the Cellar
author: Wendell Crane
blurb: Coral Eriksen, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
